newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cousins started by Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cousins started by Merrill.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Leonard Sahling said he initiated coverage of Cousins Properties Inc with near-term accumulate and long-term buy ratings.
-- estimated earnings of $1.52 a share for 1996, and $1.69 for 1997.
-- believes stock is underpriced by 10-15 percent compared to its peers in real estate development.
-- Shares closed unchanged at 25-3/4 on Monday.
-- Merrill said Cousins has "been around for 30-odd years as a public company, and lived through four or five major real estate cycles, and are very entrepreneurial."
-- "They look to what the economic environment is and adapt their investment strategy accordingly," Merrill said.

-- cited strength in building so-called "power centers," a form of neighborhood shopping center that accommodates a small group of "category killer" retailers, such as Home Depot Inc or Toys R Us Inc.
